banners.list.label: Banners in the order the home page shows them
banners.list.emptyBody: Banners are the promotional cards under the first block of the home page. Create one with a picture and a link.
banners.list.capBody: The shop keeps at most {max} banners, switched off and ended ones included. Delete one to create another.
banners.list.shownRule: The home page shows the first {shown} banners that are live now, in this order. A change can take up to a minute to appear there.
banners.list.dragHint: Change the order with the Move up and Move down buttons, or drag a row with the mouse.
banners.list.liveNotShown: Live, but not shown: only the first {shown} are
banners.list.behindShown: When it goes live it will still not appear: only the first {shown} live banners are shown. Move it up.
banners.form.altImageHintOther: Needed to switch the banner on: it is the name of the link for people who cannot see the picture.
banners.form.placement.liveNotShown: Live, but not on the home page: only the first {shown} live banners are shown. Move it up in the list.
banners.form.placement.behindShown: It will not appear until it is among the first {shown} live banners: move it up in the list.
banners.form.placement.newBehindShown: A new banner goes to the end of the list, and {shown} banners are live already: it will not appear until you move it up in the list.
banners.delete.title: Delete the banner “{name}”?
banners.delete.body: The banner disappears from the list and from the home page. The pictures stay in the media storage. This cannot be undone.
banners.delete.hint: Load the list again and check whether the banner still exists.
banners.delete.info: Deleting removes the banner from the list and from the home page. It cannot be undone; to hide a banner for a while, switch it off instead.
banners.form.layoutCardHint: The shop draws the card: your picture on top, then the title and the text, in the shop's colours.
banners.form.layoutImageHint: A finished picture you designed (for example in Figma or Canva), shown as it is, with its link.
banners.form.imageTextTitle: Text inside a picture is not read aloud
banners.form.imageTextBody: Screen readers and search engines cannot read the words in a picture. Write the same words in the picture's description of each language below.
banners.form.title: Title ({language})
banners.form.altImage: What the picture says and shows ({language})
banners.form.altCardHint: Optional: leave empty when the picture only decorates the card.
banners.form.altImageHint: Required in the main language: it is the name of the link for people who cannot see the picture.
banners.form.requiredToActivate: Required to switch the banner on: every language needs it.
banners.form.dateInvalid: Enter a date and a time.
banners.form.linkHint: A page of the shop without the language, such as /catalog, or a full address that starts with https://.
banners.form.linkExternal: This address leaves the shop: shoppers go to another site.
banners.form.active: Show this banner on the home page
banners.form.activeHintCard: To switch it on, every language needs its title.
banners.form.activeHintImage: To switch it on, every language needs its picture description.
banners.form.zone: Times are in your computer's time zone: {zone}.
banners.form.endsAtHint: Empty: no end. The banner disappears at this moment.
banners.form.endedWarning: This end is in the past: the banner will not be shown.
banners.form.timeGap: This time does not exist in your time zone (the clocks go forward): it is saved as {time}.
banners.form.timeAmbiguous: This time occurs twice in your time zone (the clocks go back): the earlier one is used, {time}.
banners.form.missingLanguage: Empty in this language while the banner is switched on: shoppers in this language see the main language's text.
banners.link.too_long: The link is too long: at most 2048 characters.
banners.link.invalid_characters: The link contains a space, a line break or a backslash.
banners.link.not_path_or_https: Enter a shop page that starts with / or an address that starts with https://.
banners.link.protocol_relative: A link that starts with // leads to another site. Enter a full https:// address instead.
banners.link.dot_segment: The link contains . or .. as a part of its path.
banners.link.locale_prefix: Leave out the language at the start: the shop adds the shopper's language itself.
banners.link.credentials: The address contains a user name or a password.
banners.picture.heading: Pictures
banners.picture.hint: Proportions 2:1, for example 1280 × 640 pixels. Keep the important part in the middle: the shop crops anything else to 2:1.
banners.picture.limits: Allowed: {types}; at most {max} MB. A picture that you do not save is deleted from the server after 24 hours. A picture you replace or remove on a saved banner stays in the shop's media storage for good (it is never deleted).
banners.picture.uploadsOffCreate: Uploading files is switched off on this server, so a new banner cannot get its picture. Ask the person who runs the shop's server.
banners.picture.uploadsOffEdit: Uploading files is switched off on this server: the pictures cannot be changed. Texts, link and dates can still be edited.
banners.picture.defaultHeading: Main picture (required; shown for every language without its own)
banners.picture.ratioOff: Not 2:1: the storefront crops the picture to 2:1. Check the preview.
banners.picture.noLocaleUsesDefault: Every language has its own picture.
banners.preview.heading: Preview
banners.preview.approximate: Approximate: the storefront uses its own fonts and widths. The card here is not a link.
banners.preview.noPicture: The picture appears here after the upload.
